important_gaps: Financial-stress core remains proposed: country equity returns/realized volatility/drawdowns, FX volatility and depreciation, corporate/sovereign credit spreads, bank-sector risk and funding-liquidity spreads. Some are derived from existing data; others require new verified vendor series.

Critical: source catalog now includes ECB CISS and FRED stress benchmarks explicitly marked as external outcomes. Do not include them in latent-index construction or as predictors for evaluating alignment to the same benchmarks.
Banxico M1/M2 modern methodology CF807 identifiers SF311408 and SF311418 are now in catalog; user must verify full historical coverage and API metadata after downloading.
FRED graph downloads failed on user's VM with ConnectionError; must resolve network access or use verified alternate source before counting US yields/M1/M2/reserves.
UK M4 is not equivalent to US/Euro area M2 or Japanese M2; different definitions/units and Euro area changing composition require explicit treatment.
US and Mexico yields and euro-area short-term/sovereign interest-rate sources require additional catalog coverage.
This revision adds ECB BSI, Bank of England IADB and BOJ official data, none yet verified by a live VM download.
Historical release/availability dates and revisions remain unaudited for all macro sources.
Source licenses and reproducibility need auditing; raw downloaded data must not be committed.
FRED ICE BofA credit OAS history is restricted to ~3 years from April 2026 on FRED; do NOT use it for a 2008-2026 test without another licensed source.
